# Archive Adoption Checklist: Spec Archive and Evidence Retention

**Purpose**: Validate SPEC-002A archive-extension adoption requirements before task generation, with focus on Racecraft fork adoption, upstream behavior validation, install/vendor verification, and Mission Control pin-recording surfaces.
**Created**: 2026-04-28
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` workflow based on SPEC-002A requirements, plan context, research findings, workflow guidance, current `.specify` extension configuration, and observed upstream `stn1slv/spec-kit-archive` behavior.

## Adoption Decision and Fork Boundary

- [x] CHK001 Is Racecraft fork adoption explicit, including direct install from a pinned fork tag/commit or vendoring an equivalent pinned copy? [Completeness, Spec FR-001, FR-011]
- [x] CHK002 Does the adoption decision require validation before Mission Control treats the archive extension as adopted? [Completeness, Spec FR-002]
- [x] CHK003 Does the specification distinguish upstream candidate evaluation from Racecraft fork adoption, so upstream behavior is not assumed to satisfy SPEC-002A without validation? [Consistency, Spec FR-001, FR-002]
- [x] CHK004 Does the adoption record require repository URL, license, pinned version/commit, and local modifications when applicable? [Completeness, Roadmap P1A-AC2, Spec FR-001, FR-003]

## Upstream Behavior and Pre-Adoption Validation

- [x] CHK005 Does the plan explicitly record the observed upstream behavior that `stn1slv/spec-kit-archive` provides a markdown/prompt command (`commands/archive.md`) rather than a proven CI-safe implementation for SPEC-002A dry-run/apply, Argos/CI provenance, cleanup gating, and recovery reporting needs? [Gap resolved, Plan §Technical Context]
- [x] CHK006 Does the specification require validation of Argos/CI provenance handling before adoption? [Completeness, Spec FR-002, FR-004, FR-014]
- [x] CHK007 Does the specification require dry-run/apply separation before adoption? [Completeness, Spec FR-002, FR-010]
- [x] CHK008 Does the specification require gated active-spec cleanup and recovery-command reporting before adoption? [Completeness, Spec FR-002, FR-006, FR-015]
- [x] CHK009 Does the archive policy keep generated screenshots out of the default durable payload while preserving provenance metadata? [Consistency, Spec FR-004, FR-014, Constitution Principle XIV]

## Mission Control Pin and Registry Evidence

- [x] CHK010 Does the specification name the Mission Control docs/config surfaces where the archive extension pin must be recorded, instead of leaving "repo-facing documentation or configuration" open-ended? [Gap resolved, Spec FR-003]
- [x] CHK011 Does the plan make installation/vendor verification explicit against the current Mission Control extension registry state, which lacks an archive extension entry? [Gap resolved, Plan §Archive Adoption Verification Surfaces]
- [x] CHK012 Does the plan state that cleanup-sensitive archive behavior must remain dry-run only in the current dirty/non-safe checkout? [Completeness, Plan §Technical Context, Plan §Gate Evaluation]
- [x] CHK013 Does the adoption path preserve reproducibility by requiring a pinned Racecraft fork tag/commit or vendored copy before Mission Control depends on the extension? [Completeness, Spec FR-003, FR-011]

## Sweep Timing and Cleanup Safety

- [x] CHK014 Does the Archive Sweep requirement say it runs at the start of `speckit-pro:autopilot` for previously merged specs only? [Clarity, Spec FR-008]
- [x] CHK015 Does the Archive Sweep exclude the current target spec until a later run sees it as merged? [Clarity, Spec FR-007, FR-008]
- [x] CHK016 Does the cleanup model require archive success plus merge/tree references and concrete recovery commands before completed spec folders can leave active `specs/**`? [Completeness, Spec FR-006, FR-015]
- [x] CHK017 Does unsafe branch or dirty worktree behavior stop or fall back to dry-run rather than mixing archive cleanup into the current feature branch? [Completeness, Spec FR-009]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK018 Is the `specs/002-product-line-switcher` dry-run case measurable without deleting source files or copying generated screenshots into source control? [Measurability, Spec SC-001]
- [x] CHK019 Can Mission Control prove the extension is installed or vendored from the Racecraft fork with the recorded pin? [Measurability, Spec SC-004]
- [x] CHK020 Do success criteria cover plugin release, local plugin refresh, Archive Sweep behavior, and recovery from removed active-spec files? [Coverage, Spec SC-003, SC-005, SC-006]

## Notes

- Initial run status: three archive-adoption requirement-writing gaps found in CHK005, CHK010, and CHK011.
- Current `.specify/extensions.yml` has `installed: []`, and `.specify/extensions/.registry` has no `archive` entry. That is valid pre-adoption evidence, not a failed implementation claim.

## Remediation Re-run

- [x] CHK021 Was the upstream behavior gap resolved by adding plan text that treats upstream `commands/archive.md` as prompt/markdown adoption context, not as proof of CI-safe Racecraft behavior? [Resolved, Plan §Technical Context]
- [x] CHK022 Was the pin-recording surface gap resolved by naming `.specify/extensions.yml`, `.specify/extensions/.registry`, vendored `.specify/extensions/archive/extension.yml`, and SPEC-002A implementation evidence in FR-003? [Resolved, Spec FR-003]
- [x] CHK023 Was the installation/vendor verification gap resolved by adding plan checks for direct-install and vendored adoption against the current registry state? [Resolved, Plan §Archive Adoption Verification Surfaces]
